name: @zhushanwen/z-subagent-workflow
description: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (default daemon thin client; the MCP tool face is offline since 1.0.0): background subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, conversation follow-ups, model routing and four-root agent .md discovery, plus built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) and custom script:<name> extension. Completion wakeup rides engine-native task-notification (CLI blocking command + Bash run_in_background), no polling.
author: zhushanwen (https://github.com/zhushanwen321)
